pages.text: Evolution needs generations, and generations need time. The $(item)Evolution Engine$() only runs where time runs at least ten times as fast - inside a $(item)Chronal Field Projector$() field. Bring a Chronal Anchor.

It evolves $(item)Telomerase Complexes$() (cells that never age) and better xenobots. The $(item)Abiogenesis Crucible$() turns $(fluid)Primordial Soup$() into the $(item)Spark of Life$(); panspermia packs life to cross between universes.
Rebuilds the clocks at the ends of chromosomes. Cells that have it do not age.$(br2)Made in $(item)Evolution Engine$().
The moment chemistry became biology, caught and kept.$(br2)Made in $(item)Abiogenesis Crucible$().
